title: LibScript Database Inventory
description: Schema for detected database instances across the host operating system.

version.description: Semantic version string extracted from the binary or protocol greeting

host.description: Hostname or IP address bound to the listener (e.g. 127.0.0.1)

socket.description: Absolute path to UNIX domain socket or Windows named pipe

service_name.description: Name of the Windows Service, systemd unit, or RC script managing the daemon

is_active.description: Indicates whether the daemon is currently running and accepting connections

source.description: Discovery mechanism used to identify the instance

existing_schemas.description: List of discovered database schema or keyspace names inside this instance
